preconditions.description: The root node of the binary tree must not be None.
The number of nodes in the binary tree must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**6 <= node.val <= 10**6 for node in nodes)
preconditions.description: The value of each node in the binary tree must be between -1,000,000 and 1,000,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum path sum from a leaf to the root as a string.
The maximum path sum must be within the range of -1,000,000 to 1,000,000.
